content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text treats Matthew 1:20 as UNDERDETERMINED because it carries two senses, covenant presence versus physical source in the womb, which is the single-verse openness the rule governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.", "room": "The phrase \"when the judge weighs two chains\" versus \"This is about one verse\": I read the judge text as weighing one verse's two senses, not two chains; if it were weighing two chains, the rule would not apply.", "why": "The judge's stated ground is that Matthew 1:20 has two answers or senses, so K-S2 requires both senses to stand and forbids UNDERDETERMINED on that basis."}
